title: torangles: torsion-angle distributions
purpose: Exercises `torangles`, which computes intramolecular torsion (dihedral) angle distributions [@epsrmanual]: for every molecule whose first atom has type `atom1`, the dihedral about the axis between molecule atoms `ltyp1`-`ltyp2`, the end points being the mid-points of the atom pairs `ltyp3` (bonded to the first axis atom) and `ltyp4` (to the second). Distributions over -180..180° are accumulated and each molecule's angles are listed.
system: Analysed configuration: `200DMSO400Water.ato`, an unchanged copy of the EPSR-test box of 200 dimethyl sulphoxide (DMSO; atom types S, O, C, H) and 400 water molecules (O1, H1): 3200 atoms, DMSO mole fraction 1/3, 300 K, cubic box of side 33.1213 Å (0.0881 atoms/Å³), the EPSR model of the deuterated DMSO-water neutron data (ISIS SANDALS runs SLS03863, SLS03871, SLS03850), cf. [@soperluzar1992]. Torsions (atom numbers within the molecule: DMSO S1, C2, C3, O4, H5-H10): O4-S1-C2-H5, the methyl rotation relative to the S=O bond; C2-S1-C3-mid(H8,H9), using the mid-point of two methyl hydrogens; and a degenerate water 'torsion' O-H-H with all end points on atom 3 (`ltyp3 3 3`, `ltyp4 3 3`). 72 bins of 5°. In the EPSR model the DMSO methyl groups are rotational groups (`ROT` entries in the `.ato` file), so the H5 torsion samples the methyl rotation.
inputs: `dmso.TOR.dat`: `nsize 72`, `nsumt 0`, three distributions as above (`atom1 S` twice, `atom1 O1`); `200DMSO400Water.ato` copied unchanged from EPSR-test.
verification: `repeat 2` with `nsumt 0`: pass 2 reads `dmso.TOR.c01` back and averages. Compared after each pass: `dmso.TOR.c01` (three distributions with spreads), the rewritten `dmso.TOR.dat` and `toranglesvalues.txt`, the angles of every molecule written with the run-time format `(1x,i6,n(1x,e14.7))` built by the program. The configuration is the same in every pass, so the chained passes test the read-back of the accumulated file and the running-average arithmetic.
